revenue_scope: U.S. Xifaxan net product revenue: Salix's net product revenues table (2004Q3-2014Q3), then the Xifaxan line of Valeant / Bausch Health's earnings-deck slides (2015Q2-2021Q4 'Top 10 Products - Salix' and earlier top-brand slides; 2025Q4-2026Q2 'Salix Segment' slides), with 2022Q3 and 2022Q4 derived from the year-to-date and full-year Xifaxan revenues Bausch Health's 10-Qs and 10-K print. The Salix segment is defined in the FY2025 10-K (0000885590-26-000023, Note 23) as 'sales in the U.S. of GI products'; the 2016 top-30 decks print '% Sold outside US' as 0% for Xifaxan; the 3Q20 and 4Q21 Salix slides are footnoted 'U.S. sales only'.
moa: Rifamycin antibacterial (RNA polymerase inhibitor), minimally absorbed
series_end_reason: Bausch Health's earnings presentations keep printing Xifaxan on the Salix segment slide after 2021 (q1-2026 deck slide 12: 559; q2-2026 deck slide 15: 664), but the 2022-2025 decks were not read in full, so the series stops at 2021Q4, the last quarter of a contiguous sourced run.
search_log: Listed every Salix filing (all forms incl. 10-Q/A, 10-K/A, 8-K) for CIK 0001009356 via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older pages (scripts/common.py); product rows parsed from the net-product-revenue-by-product table of each 10-Q/10-K/10-Q/A/10-K/A (scripts/salix.py). Salix earnings 8-Ks print Xifaxan mostly in prose, so the periodic reports are the cited documents.

Xifaxan first sold in 2004Q3 (Salix 10-Q for 2004Q3: Xifaxan product revenues for the three- and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2004 were $9.7 million; Xifaxan launched in the US in 2004); 2004Q1-Q2 had no sales. 2004Q3 is cited to the 2005Q3 10-Q prior-year column because the 2004 10-Q prints it only in text.

Q4 of every year derived as 10-K full year less 10-Q nine months (no Q4 table row in the 10-Ks). 2013Q4 uses the 10-K/A (restated FY2013 635,941); 2014Q1-Q3 use the 10-Q/As filed 2015-03-02 (restated), 2014Q4 = FY2014 10-K 405,442 less restated nine months 412,740 = (7,298) thousand. Original (pre-restatement) values are given in each row's context.

Salix to Valeant, 2014Q4-2015Q1: Valeant acquired Salix on 2015-04-01 and Salix filed no Q1 2015 report (last filing 2015-04-23). Valeant/Bausch Health 8-K releases, 10-Qs and 10-Ks (CIK 885590) were scanned for table rows labelled Xifaxan: none prints a quarterly Xifaxan row. The FY2021 10-K prints annual Xifaxan revenue ($1,644 million, $1,482 million, $1,452 million for 2021, 2020, 2019); the Valeant 4Q15 deck shows Xifaxan 2Q15 148, 3Q15 220, 4Q15 205. 2015Q1 is not reported by either company, so no splice is made over 2014Q4-2015Q1.

EXTENSION (outcome A): Valeant CIK 885590 filing list read via data.sec.gov (main and older-page JSON); Item 2.02 8-K exhibit 99.1 releases for 2015-04 to 2018-02 opened (Q2 2015 release 0001193125-15-260449, Q1 2016 0001193125-16-566125 among them) and carry Xifaxan in prose only (no quarterly sales), so the sources are the IR earnings decks.

Decks fetched from ir.valeant.com / ir.bauschhealth.com and read with pdfplumber: Q2 2015 (August 2015 revision), Q3 2015, Q4/FY2015 final v4, Q1 2016, Q2 2016, Q3 2016, 4Q/FY2016, 1Q17, 2Q17, 3Q17, 4Q/FY2017, 1Q18, 2Q18, 3Q18, 4Q18/FY18. The original 15 March 2016 Q4 2015 deck was not located (only the final v4 of 2016-04-29).
Q1 2015: Xifaxan prints a dash in Valeant's Q1 2015 column (Q2 2015 and Q3 2015 decks, and the Q1 2016 deck's restated column), consistent with Salix filing no Q1 2015 report.

Form 10-Q, 10-K and 10-Q/A for 2022Q1 through 2026Q2 (19 Bausch Health periodic reports, CIK 885590, listed via data.sec.gov and downloaded) were searched for HTML table rows containing Xifaxan with a figure (none) and for Xifaxan sentences carrying a dollar amount in the text. Printed amounts: six months 2022 $775 million vs $768 million (10-Q 0000885590-22-000039, also in the 10-Q/A 0000885590-22-000042); nine months 2022 $1,216 million vs $1,194 million (10-Q 0000885590-22-000061); full years $1,692 million (2022, 10-K 0000885590-23-000009), $1,810 million (2023, 10-K 0000885590-24-000011), $1,993 million (2024, 10-K 0000885590-25-000007) and $2,212 million (2025, 10-K 0000885590-26-000023). The 1Q22 10-Q and every 2023-2026 10-Q print Xifaxan only as a share of the Salix segment (about 80% then 85%), an intangible carrying value or a volume driver, with no dollar revenue.
Not done: a check of the 4Q15 original deck, and of 10-K annual Xifaxan revenue for 2015-2017 against the deck sums.

VERIFIER CORRECTION: the earlier statement that the decks from 1Q22 on print no quarterly Xifaxan figure was wrong; Bausch Health's 1Q26 and 2Q26 decks (q1-2026-earnings-presentation.pdf slide 12, q2-2026-earnings-presentation.pdf slide 15, 'Salix Segment' slides) print Xifaxan product revenue of 559 and 664 millions USD, so issuer_stopped_reporting at 2021Q4 was unsupported.

FULL READ OF THE 2022-2026 DECKS: the PDF text of every Bausch Health earnings deck from 1Q22 through 2Q26 (1Q22 20220510-1q22-earnings-presentation, 2q22-earnings-presentation, 3q22-bhc-slides-final, 4q22-and-fy22-earnings-presentation, 1q2023-earnings-presentation, 2q23-earnings-presentation, 3q23-earnings-presentation, q4-and-fy-2023-earnings-presentation, bhc-1q24-earnings-presentation, bhc-2q24-earnings-presentation, 3q24-earnings-deck, 4q24-earnings-deck, 1q25-earnings-deck, 2q25-earnings-deck, 3q25-earnings-deck, 4q-and-fy-2025-earnings-deck, q1-2026-earnings-presentation, q2-2026-earnings-presentation, all under https://ir.bauschhealth.com/~/media/Files/V/Valeant-IR/reports-and-presentations/) was extracted with pdfplumber and every line containing Xifaxan read. Xifaxan is printed with a dollar revenue only on the 'Salix Segment' slides of the 4Q25 (607), 1Q26 (559) and 2Q26 (664) decks, where the product name is a logo image. The 1Q25 and 3Q25 Salix Segment slides were also viewed as images: they print the segment total and mix share and a Xifaxan percentage change (8% and 16%), not a Xifaxan dollar figure. The 1Q24 and 2Q24 decks' $499 and $558 are segment totals (1Q25 slide: $542 total, 85% Xifaxan). The 1Q22-4Q24 decks print Xifaxan growth percentages and script data only. Text layer only: chart images in other slides were not individually viewed.

Bausch Health Form 8-K Item 2.02 earnings releases for 3Q25, 4Q25, 1Q26 and 2Q26 (exhibits 99.1, accessions 0000885590-25-000048, -26-000020, -26-000051, -26-000105) print Xifaxan only as a percentage growth (16%, 21%, 26%) or without a figure; no dollar amount.

Bausch Health 2Q20 deck: not found on ir.bauschhealth.com (2020 events-and-presentations page lists no quarterly deck; guessed file names 2q20-bausch-health-earnings-presentation, -deck and 2q20-earnings-presentation return 404), so 2020Q2 stays on the 3Q20 deck's trailing column.

joined_issuers.issuer: Valeant Pharmaceuticals International (renamed Bausch Health Companies in 2018)

unreported_quarters.2014Q4: Ownership change Salix to Valeant, first part: Salix's only fourth-quarter 2014 figure is the 10-K full year (405,442 thousand) less the restated nine months (412,740 thousand), which is negative (-7,298 thousand) from mixed bases, and no Salix document prints the quarter directly. Valeant's decks show a dash for the product in the quarters before 2Q15.
unreported_quarters.2015Q1: Ownership change Salix to Valeant on 1 April 2015: Salix filed no report for 2015Q1 (its last filing is dated 2015-04-23) and Valeant's Q1 2015 column for Xifaxan is a dash on the Q2 2015 deck (Top 20 Brands slide) and the Q3 2015 deck (Top 30 Brands slide), and '-' under Q1 2015 (restated) on the Q1 2016 deck.

reviewed_anomalies.2015Q2: First Valeant quarter; the value steps from Salix's restated 155.815 (2014Q3) to 148; the 2Q15 and 3Q15 releases describe Salix wholesaler inventory reductions in these quarters, which was not analysed further.
reviewed_anomalies.2015Q4: Read from the final restated Q4 2015 deck; its footnote 2 says sales changed from the 15 March 2016 presentation because of additional adjustments (the 8-K of 2016-04-29 states Valeant reduced its previously reported preliminary Q4 2015 revenue by about $5 million of estimated Xifaxan returns).

notes: Series 2004Q3-2014Q3 is Salix's own U.S. net product revenue; 2015Q2-2021Q4 is the Xifaxan line Valeant (Bausch Health from 2018) prints in its quarterly deck slides, in whole millions; 2022Q3 and 2022Q4 are derived from Bausch Health's 10-Q and 10-K amounts (nine months 2022 1,216 less six months 775; full year 1,692 less nine months 1,216), and 2025Q4-2026Q2 are the Xifaxan row of the 'Salix Segment' slide. Between them 2022Q1, 2022Q2 and 2023Q1-2025Q3 are not printed as quarterly Xifaxan dollars in any document read and are listed in unreported_quarters; the printed annual amounts for 2022-2025 (1,692; 1,810; 1,993; 2,212 millions) are in the 10-Ks and 2022 sums to the derived quarters only with the six-month 775 for 2022Q1+Q2. The 1Q26 and 2Q26 decks' 'Change ($)' columns (98, 135) imply prior-year amounts for 2025Q1 and 2025Q2 and the 4Q25 deck's (56) one for 2024Q4, but a prior-year amount obtained as current less change is not printed and is not entered. Territory: Valeant's Q1 2016 and Q2 2016 decks print '% Sold outside US' = 0% for Xifaxan; the 3Q20 and 4Q21 'Top 10 Products - Salix' slides carry the footnote 'U.S. sales only' and the 'Total BAUSCH Health' slides of those decks are footnoted 'Global sales' (4Q21 total-company prints Xifaxan 451 against 450 on the Salix slide); in the 4Q18 deck the Salix-slide footnote concerns the segment realignment, so 2018-2019 scope rests on the Salix-slide figures equalling the global-total slide figures and 2016-2017 on the 2016 '0% sold outside US' evidence; from 2022 the FY2025 10-K (Note 23) defines the Salix segment as 'sales in the U.S. of GI products' and the 10-K's annual Xifaxan amounts for 2021 and 2020 (1,644; 1,482) equal this series' annual sums. 2015Q4 is read from the restated v4 deck because the original March 2016 deck was not found. Rows 2019Q1-2021Q4 are the rows of companion bausch_xifaxan_alt unchanged; 2018Q1-2018Q4 are re-read from the 1Q18, 2Q18, 3Q18 and 4Q18 decks. Annual sums: 2016 = 932, 2017 = 979 (printed FY17 979), 2018 = 1,195 (printed), 2019 = 1,452 (printed FY19), 2020 = 1,482, 2021 = 1,644 (printed).
